title: Going Shopping
context: Grocery shopping: the list, the aisles, asking where things are, paying. Short practical phrases you use at the supermarket every week.
contextPersian: خرید خواربار: لیست خرید، قفسه‌ها، پرسیدن جای اجناس، پرداخت. عبارت‌های کوتاه و کاربردی که هر هفته در فروشگاه لازم داری.

expressions.example: I usually do the shopping on Friday afternoons.
expressions.note: 'Do the shopping' = groceries routine; 'go shopping' = shopping as an outing (often clothes).

expressions.example: Let me make a shopping list so we don't forget anything.
expressions.examplePersian: بگذار لیست خرید بنویسم که چیزی یادمان نرود.

expressions.example: We've run out of milk and eggs.
expressions.note: Extremely common: run out of time, money, patience.

expressions.example: Can you pick up some bread on your way home?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود سر راه خانه نان بگیری؟

expressions.example: Excuse me, where can I find the rice?
The cooking oil is in aisle three, next to the pasta.
expressions.examplePersian: روغن در راهروی سه است، کنار پاستا.

expressions.example: How much is this cheese per kilo?
Grab two — they're on sale this week.
expressions.examplePersian: دو تا بردار — این هفته حراج‌اند.

expressions.example: Can I pay by card, or is it cash only?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌توانم با کارت پرداخت کنم یا فقط نقدی است؟

expressions.example: Could I get a receipt, please?

exercises.after: of milk — can you pick some up?

exercises.prompt: You can't find the sugar in the supermarket. You ask:
options: Where can I find the sugar?
exercises.explanation: Natural question: Where can I find...?

exercises.prompt: The chocolate is cheaper this week because it's ___.

exercises.source: می‌شود سر راه خانه نان بگیری؟
acceptedAnswers: Can you pick up some bread on your way home?
Could you pick up some bread on your way home?
Can you pick up bread on your way home?

speakingTask.instruction: Say what you need to buy this week and ask two questions you'd ask in the shop.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: بگو این هفته چه چیزهایی باید بخری و دو سوالی که در فروشگاه می‌پرسی را بگو.
modelSentences: I need to do the shopping — we've run out of rice and milk.
Excuse me, where can I find the olive oil?
How much is this per kilo?

roleplay.aiRole: A supermarket employee helping a customer
roleplay.learnerRole: A customer with a shopping list who can't find several items
roleplay.objective: Ask for locations and prices, respond to suggestions, pay at the end
roleplay.context: The learner is shopping for the week: can't find two items, asks prices, learns something is on sale, pays by card.
roleplay.opening: Hi, you look a bit lost — can I help you find something?
